player_prompt.intro:
Ngeye Mwana {player_id} mu kipindi kya Reverse Tic Tac Toe. Mfumo ngeye ni '{symbol}'.
Kipimo ni kukwepa kupata misemo mitatu mfululizo (kwa mpimo wa kisanduku, kwa wima, au kwa diagonal).
Ukafanya misemo mitatu mfululizo, ukaloba.
Tumishe kibali chako kwa mfumo '[4]' ili kuweka mfumo ngeye mu sanduku 4.
Ngeye Mwana {player_id}, ngeye '{symbol}' na mpingani ngeye ni '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.invalid_cell: Tshikena-bualu tshia mu kasumbu kakayi tshiakane.

game_action.placed: Mwadi {player_id} akabwaka symbol yake ({symbol}) mu celu {cell}.

outcome.loss: Muena manaya {player_id} udi upangila padiye ujikija mulongo!
